messages.subject: Move 'x' label?
parts:
Hi

In this example 3.5 is overlapping with wt. C

library(ggvis)
mtcars %>% ggvis( ~ wt, ~ mpg) %>%
  layer_points() %>%
  add_axis("x", properties = axis_props(labels = list(
    angle = 45, align = "left", fontSize = 20
  )))

an I move wt down? can I make it bigger and or bold?

Thanks!
